conflicts.permit: GeaxGame may also obtain the billing and payment information that you provide when your purchase is processed by someone else (like Facebook, Apple or Google) such as when you purchase something in a game you play on a social network or that you downloaded on your mobile device.
conflicts.prohibit: GeaxGame does not collect or store your financial information, like credit card numbers.
conflicts.situation: When a user makes an in-game purchase processed through a platform like Facebook, Apple, or Google that includes payment or financial information.
conflicts.reason: One sentence explicitly states GeaxGame does not collect financial information, while another statement affirms GeaxGame may obtain billing and payment information from third-party processors without reconciling the restriction.
